title: Hedged washout
note: ACR tie-break hides a possible LR-5
report: Segment VI: 18 mm observation with nonrim arterial phase hyperenhancement. Possible subtle washout on the portal venous phase. No enhancing capsule. No prior imaging available for comparison.

title: Contradictory impression
note: Audit mode: findings say LR-5, impression says LR-3
report:
Segment VII: 2.5 cm observation with arterial phase hyperenhancement, non-peripheral washout and an enhancing capsule. Stable compared with the prior study.
Impression: LI-RADS 3.

title: 19 mm near the cut-off
report:
Segment VIII: 19 mm observation with nonrim arterial phase hyperenhancement. No washout. No capsule. Unchanged from the prior study 4 months ago.
Impression: LR-3.

title: Unsure but harmless
report:
Segment V: 24 mm observation with arterial phase hyperenhancement and nonperipheral washout. Questionable thin capsule. No interval growth.
Impression: LR-5.

title: Small, no APHE
report:
Segment II: 8 mm observation without arterial phase hyperenhancement. No washout. No capsule. Stable compared with prior imaging.
Impression: LR-3.

title: Rim enhancement
note: Out of scope: deferred to radiologist (possible LR-M)
report:
Segment IV: 32 mm mass with rim arterial phase hyperenhancement and peripheral washout. Targetoid restricted diffusion.
Impression: LR-M.

title: Growth on follow-up
note: Threshold growth makes a 14 mm lesion LR-5
report:
Segment III: 14 mm observation with nonrim arterial phase hyperenhancement, previously 8 mm five months ago, consistent with threshold growth. No washout. No capsule.
Impression: LR-4.

title: Missing size
report: Segment VI: small observation with arterial phase hyperenhancement and washout. No capsule.

title: Two observations
note: Multi-lesion report: one decision-critical, one contradicted
report:
Observation 1: Segment VI, 18 mm observation with nonrim arterial phase hyperenhancement. Possible subtle washout on the portal venous phase. No enhancing capsule. No prior imaging available for comparison.
Observation 2: Segment II, 26 mm observation with arterial phase hyperenhancement, nonperipheral washout and an enhancing capsule. Stable compared with the prior study.
Impression: 1. LI-RADS 3. 2. LI-RADS 4.
